correctness.rationale: The two-state first-event recurrence has exactly the displayed quadratic transform factor. Strong Markov renewal after each removal yields independent stages, positive quadratic roots yield an exact hypoexponential law, and summing inverse rates proves moments. A finite Gamma-product identity and centered characteristic functions rigorously establish Gaussian–Gumbel convolution for b_N√N/a→θ finite and centered Gumbel when that ratio diverges. Independent finite-state generator computations reproduce 720 transforms and 180 mean/variance cases, with 1.92e-15 maximum transform error, and numerical characteristic-function convergence; finite checks are not substitutes for proof. Assumptions, boundary b=0, all m and all N, and fixed a,γ in asymptotics were reviewed.

value.rationale: Hard-core crowding and a localized absorbing hub are natural exclusion-transport objects. This theorem gives a complete finite-N full-clearance law, all initial occupancy numbers, exact moments, and a sharp parameter scale b_N∼a/√N separating two universality limits; at that scale a nontrivial independent Gaussian-plus-Gumbel law appears. The exact limiting law gives meaningful finite-network extinction benchmarks and quantifies return transport, rather than a routine single numerical instance.
